items.title: This Swedish bitcoin treasury firm lost 30 BTC trading part of its own stack
items.teaser: Stockholm-listed H100 moved a slice of its bitcoin into a derivatives book after an August acquisition and has shed nearly $2 million worth of BTC by the end of September.

items.title: Chainflip’s losses climb to $12 million after protocol discloses 122.9 BTC theft, offers hacker bounty
items.teaser: Chainflip offered the attacker a 10% bounty to return the remainder of the $12 million in stolen BTC, ETH, and stablecoins by Monday.
